I say this one a lot because people keep getting it twisted...

Your job pays you. That's the deal, and it's a fair one. But the thing they're paying for? The way you think, the problems you solve, the reason people at work come to YOU... that was yours before the title and it'll be yours after.

So be real with me. What's the thing people come to you for that has nothing to do with your job title?

Don't rush to the LLC...

I know that's what everybody tells you to do first. File the paperwork, get the logo, order the cards. And now you've got a company nobody trusts yet, attached to a face nobody has seen.

People trust people. Let them meet YOU first. Face first, then build the thing that can stand without you. It's a sequence, not a choice.

I built mine while I was still on payroll, and on Tuesday October 20th at 7pm EST I'm going live, free, to walk you through how. The Corporate Entrepreneur. Link in bio.
